Additive-only: `git diff -U0 main...HEAD` over all 11 files shows zero deletion lines and zero '+'/'-' lines containing '.zig' -- every citation's path text survives purely as unchanged diff context; the 43 added lines are all exactly 'PROVENANCE (historical, not current decision authority):' or its '#'-prefixed YAML-comment form, placed immediately above the first line of the paragraph/YAML sequence item carrying the citation, with indentation matched to the surrounding YAML block. Per-file .zig grep counts are identical before (git show main:<file>) and after in every one of the 11 files (85:10/10, 86:9/9, 87:7/7, 93:2/2, 94:4/4, 95:4/4, 96:5/5, 97:2/2, 98:4/4, 99:3/3, 100:3/3) -- confirms zero citation lines lost; marker counts are lower than raw .zig-line counts in several files (e.g. ISS-0086: 9 zig-lines but 7 markers) because several .zig mentions share one blank-line-bounded paragraph or wrapped sentence, exactly the many-to-one relationship the design doc's own section 5 verification method anticipates (one marker per citation *unit*, not per .zig occurrence). r_co_sources: sequence-item shape: read the design doc (lib/letflow/design/req237-zig-provenance-marking-convention.md) section 2's shape-4(a) definition directly -- it is written key-name-agnostically ('a bare #-prefixed comment line immediately above a single ... sequence-item bullet'), naming acceptance_criteria bullets and id:/title: pairs only as its two worked examples, not as an exhaustive list of eligible YAML keys. REQ-260's handoff (handoffs/WF02-REQ260-20260905/step01-doc-updater.json) already applied this identical extension to r_co_evidence:/letflow_evidence: sequences in ISS-0078/ISS-0079 and recorded it as a MINOR judgement-call note, reasoning that these are 'structurally identical to the design doc's already-documented acceptance_criteria-bullet YAML sequence-item case ... both are "- ..."-shaped YAML sequence items.' REQ-261's application of the same reasoning to a third same-shaped key (r_co_sources:, in ISS-0085/0086/0087) is a consistent, non-inventive continuation of an already-reviewed extension -- same YAML-sequence-of-citation-strings semantics, no new marker text, no new regex, no new placement rule. This does not require a fresh CODE-DESIGNER pass; it is squarely inside REQ-237's mechanical, per-unit placement rule as already vetted by a prior REVIEWER gate (WF02-REQ254-20260905's finding that motivated the ISS-0510 amendment in the first place). No other field altered: full diffs (git diff -U1) were read directly for all 11 files -- every hunk shows only a single added PROVENANCE line above a paragraph or sequence item; status/resolution/resolution_note/severity/reconciliation_note text bodies are unchanged verbatim aside from the marker line inserted above them.
